resources.string: Your time, organized in one expressive dashboard
Quiet motion, expressive color, and a clear clock-first hierarchy.
A calmer way to read time
Your everyday time tools in one calm workspace, designed to feel immediate and effortless.
Keep cities close, compare their local time, and open any city for a focused detail view.
Chrona can check the public release feed in the background while leaving installation entirely in your hands.
Preview selected · tap the hero card again to reset
A live, persistent view of your saved cities
Use the + button to search the timezone catalog.
Updates continuously from the unified Chrona time engine.
Schedules that stay editable without leaving the list
Create a schedule and tune repeat, sound and vibration from the same editor.
Build a complete schedule with time, repeat and alert behavior.
Tune this schedule without leaving the alarm list.
Tap the dial to set the alarm time
Build a duration with numbers, then let Chrona count it down
Paused - resume when you are ready
Timer completion is scheduled through Chrona Android alarm layer so it can survive the UI leaving the foreground.
Tune appearance, clock behavior, updates, and app information.
Show the live seconds readout in the hero clock
